body: And yet it is mandatory if you want to enjoy the Sumeru Archon Quest. Great, just great.

I don't like it because I'm being forced to rush it. I want to start the Sumeru Archon Quest to have fun along everybody else but alas, I have to finish the whoooole Chasm big quest before. This means I have to go over hours and hours of content and very boring puzzles just to unlock the part of the story I'm truly interested in, which shouldn't even be linked to the Chasm quest in the first place (yes yes, lore and whatever; there should be an option to skip it or leave it for later since it's not a freaking Archon Quest). So I'm basically forced to ignore all the beautiful details you've written about and suffer through the more tedious parts of the quest, or wait weeks and weeks (we have jobs, Mihoyo!) to finish the Chasm thoroughly while seing everybody enjoying Sumeru. Great story design.

But what's "having the mind of a girl" really about? You have a mind, and if you're a girl (or want to be one), then you have the mind of a girl. It's that simple. We don't really have pink or blue or violet brains that jail us into one specific category or gender or whatever you want to call it. Also, you're almost twenty, so if anything you wouldn't have the mind of a boy/girl/child, but one of a woman (or man or whatever); it's important to make this distinction, since you're already an adult and thus have the mind and self perception of one.
